items.title: 浅谈一下使用Claude和ChatGPT的感受
items.summary:
浅谈一下使用Claude和ChatGPT的感受

我是GPT和claude 双会员，而且都开到最高级了

GPT给我的感觉就是一个非常牛逼的博士生，它的后台框架能力很强，codex的代码编程水平很高，而且很省，我个人觉得后台它比claude做的好，有什么bug你跟它讲它立刻就能修复的让你满意。

但是GPT的问题是以下几个：

第一，它的前端审美一坨屎，几乎没有审美，你说它是理科生审美都是在骂理科生。

第二，不爱说人话，你不论跟它说什么，它都要跟你平衡，仿佛你说太阳是东升西江，它也要特意跟你说在当前情况下的的地球是这样的，就是不喜欢强调绝对性语句，一定要保持它那该死的客观公正的态势。

比如我问他我身体不舒服大概什么原因，他说了半天我字都认识，就是不知道它想说什么。

然后就是GPT属于你的框架知识越足够，准备的越充分，它越厉害，你不说的地方它半点不做，它不会多干一点，简直就像博士生毕业之前的状态。

Claude 的一个巨大的优点就是理解审美，理解语言，而且claude在我个人感觉它的某一些地方相当恐怖。

它能get到我的喜好，而且像一个超级牛逼会读心术的舔狗，你不需要像调教GPT一样，你说一句他干一句。claude会直接提前帮你规划好几步，甚至把你个人常用的一些手法和方式都融入进来，哪怕你没说，我严重怀疑claude在分析用户做用户情绪监测。

其次，claude有一些很吓人的体验经历，比如我有一次在做游戏项目开发，用claude跑代码，然后claude突然给我来了一句我的电脑有木马，让我删除，申请它来执行，然后它不仅找到了这一个，一会给我把电脑所有的木马记录和执行记录以及信息输送的经过全部告诉我了。

但你要知道，这不是我主动要求它做的，而是它自然而然的突然在开发游戏的过程中发现了一个毫不相关的进程。

这件事当时就让我蒙圈了，我真的完全想不到agent到了这种可怕的地步，它是建立了一个监测程序专门去盯着cpu进程，因为它觉得自己运行效率太低了，结果发现了木马，然后它没有问，直接就开始追踪，结果找到7个，还自动化运行清理，最后发现需要管理员，才让我搞。

如果你不理解吓人的地方在哪，那就当我没说。

我用GPT已经很久很久了，从来没有出现过这种情况它就像个傻子一样每天在那说废话，有时候规划任务都规划半天，之前我是不敢给claude权限，但是GPT的前端开发噪声太大了，我嫌弃它听不懂我说什么换claude，一个月进度翻了5倍。

我现在就是让claude 管着gpt做后台，效率很高。

以上仅代表个人使用感受，有其他想法或者意见欢迎一起交流。

items.title: Military-made AI tool helped thwart World Cup bomb threat - Federal News Network
items.summary:
A military-made artificial intelligence tool helped law enforcement thwart a bomb threat at the FIFA World Cup in California this summer.

The previously undisclosed incident occurred June 18, when Switzerland faced Bosnia and Herzegovina at SoFi Stadium outside Los Angeles, Army Capt. Ryan Hetrick, who leads the Pentagon’s Generative AI Task Force, said Nov. 6 at an AI event in Washington. [...] Hetrick pointed to a recent visit to the 101st Airborne Division at Fort Campbell, Kentucky, where he built an AI tool that cut the time it takes to execute a particular cyber operations workflow from 100 hours to 15. That tool is now available to all cyber officers across the department, he said.

“We don’t do policy shops. We don’t do PowerPoints. We go to the edge and build with the warfighter,” he said. “You can’t be building agents from the Pentagon.” [...] He urged others across the military to adopt his hands-on approach to AI integration, encouraging troops to partner with AI experts to learn cutting-edge techniques and to tap innovative service members as in-house AI gurus who can spread that knowledge further.

items.title: From scans to scribes, Yale medical faculty talk AI use in healthcare | Yale Daily News
items.summary:
Normally, diagnosing prostate cancer includes a blood test, MRI imaging and a formal diagnosis from a radiologist, who might read the same MRI image differently on different days.

Now, Onofrey said, he and other researchers are training deep learning models on these images to look for diseases including prostate cancer, though he said researchers have not validated models in large enough settings for clinical adoption yet. [...] Technology companies will face skepticism, according to Papademetris. Many AI models remain “black box” models, meaning users do not know the details of the inner workings behind the AI used in practice.

Though scientific advancement is exciting, Papademetris cautioned about implementing AI into healthcare without the proper guardrails in place. [...] Some provider systems, such as Yale Health, have incorporated AI scribes to help draft notes from patient visits. Yale researchers and professors spoke to the News about their experiences with AI-powered tools. Xenophon Papademetris, a professor at the School of Medicine, said people should be skeptical of AI use in everyday clinical practice.

items.summary: Ông Nguyễn Khắc Lịch cho rằng thông tư này nhằm bảo vệ người tiêu dùng, phát triển thị trường trong nước. Cụ thể sẽ bảo đảm an toàn thông tin mạng, sức khỏe người dùng và môi trường, đồng thời ngăn chặn nguy cơ Việt Nam trở thành điểm tiếp nhận rác thải điện tử từ nước ngoài. Bên cạnh đó sẽ hạn chế rủi ro mất an toàn thông tin, lộ lọt dữ liệu cá nhn từ các thiết bị phần cứng không rõ nguồn gốc đã bị can thiệp kỹ thuật; giảm thiểu nguy cơ cháy nổ từ linh kiện, pin đã xuống cấp và bảo đảm tương [...] Cục trưởng Cục Công nghệ số và Trí tuệ nhn tạo nhấn mạnh thông tư này sẽ hỗ trợ hoạt động sản xuất, kinh doanh cho doanh nghiệp Việt Nam với việc kiểm soát chặt hàng tiêu dùng công nghệ cũ. Cụ thể, dy chuyền công nghệ, máy móc, thiết bị, công cụ đã qua sử dụng đáp ứng tiêu chí theo pháp luật về công nghiệp công nghệ số, phục vụ trực tiếp cho dự án đầu tư sản xuất, đóng gói, kiểm thử sản phẩm vi mạch bán dẫn hoặc hoạt động đào tạo, nghiên cứu và phát triển sản phẩm, dịch vụ công nghệ số vẫn được [...] số 11/TT-BTTTT ngày 15-10-2018 của Bộ Thông tin và Truyền thông công bố chi tiết Danh mục sản phẩm công nghệ thông tin đã qua sử dụng cấm nhập.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: AI² Robotics Joins Indonesia’s National Strategic Industries | Gasgoo
items.summary:
Underpinning this deployment is AI² Robotics's integrated "Model × Hardware × Scenario" capability. The approach centers on a brain-like embodied large model as the intelligence core, mass-producible and stable robotic bodies as the vehicle, and real-world productivity scenarios as the driving force. [...] Gasgoo Munich-On November 9, AI² Robotics announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Danantara Development Management Fund (DDMF), the investment arm of Indonesia's state-backed wealth fund Danantara Indonesia. The partnership will focus on pilot applications, industrial collaboration, and local deployment of general-purpose intelligent robots and embodied AI technology across the archipelago. [...] The agreement was signed during the inaugural Danantara Technology Innovation Investment Forum (DTIIF 2026) in Jakarta, with Zhang Peng, AI² Robotics's co-founder, signing on behalf of the company.

Image Credit: AI² Robotics

Operating independently under the president's office, Danantara Indonesia holds substantial influence. AI² Robotics is now the first—and currently the only—robotics company to join DDMF's embodied AI cooperation roster.

items.title: ListEasier introduces AI robotics for automated e-commerce listings
items.summary:
Find out more

Under the system, robotics hardware places items, captures images from several angles using computer vision and records spatial dimensions without manual intervention.

ListEasier’s vision and natural language processing models then analyse the visual data, extract product attributes, identify condition details and generate listing metadata. [...] Its PriceEasier engine calculates price points across global marketplaces, while completed catalogue profiles are sent to sales channels and marketplaces in seconds.

ListEasier said the launch covers warehouse automation, industrial reverse logistics and high-volume e-commerce inventory processing, segments it estimates represent a C$45bn (US$31.89bn) total addressable market.

The system is designed to reduce manual labour requirements and inspection delays in listing workflows, it added. [...] The launch follows the company’s reported milestone of listing more than $200m in gross merchandise value and a sixfold increase in data-processing speed.

ListEasier co-founder and COO Josh van der Meulen said: “Transitioning AI out of the browser and directly onto the warehouse floor represents a structural shift in inventory processing. We are turning manual physical inventory intake into a high-speed, automated assembly line.”

items.title: Autonomous EV developer Humble Robotics adds $51M to expand - TT
items.summary:
Humble Robotics raised $51 million in Series A financing, bringing its total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding.
 The company is developing the Humble Hauler, a battery-electric, cabless Class 8 autonomous vehicle for regional freight routes under 250 miles.
 Humble will fund customer pilots, testing, early manufacturing and expansion into vehicles for 40-foot containers and 53-foot dry van and refrigerated trailers. [...] Stay on top of transportation news: [Get TTNews in your inbox.]

Humble Robotics secured $51 million in new financing, bringing the autonomous electric vehicle developer’s total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding. [...] The Hauler uses vision-language-action models and is equipped with cameras, lidar and radar that provide 360-degree coverage of its surroundings. The battery-electric skateboard platform has an aerodynamic shield at the front, while shipping containers can be attached through a twist-lock interface.

items.title: Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program earns regional recognition - ClarksvilleNow.com
items.summary:
“I am proud of the national-level success of Kenwood’s Robotics Team. It reflects the faculty, JROTC instructors, and cadets’ hard work and dedication toward creating an elite mindset at the school,” Lightner said.

Dr Nigel Anderson, Kenwood High School Principal, noted “The robotics program complements the leadership development and citizenship training provided through JROTC while exposing students to science, technology, engineering, and mathematics disciplines.” [...] CLARKSVILLE TN – The Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program has grown from a single robotics team into a four-team program that is competing successfully at regional and national-level events. The program currently fields Teams 26163X, 26163A, 26163L, and 26163S, providing students with opportunities to develop skills in engineering, programming, and problem-solving. [...] During the current robotics’ competition season, Team 26163X captured first place at the Tennessee State Fair Robotics Competition. The team followed that performance with another first-place finish at a competition in Elizabethton, Tennessee, where it also received a technical award recognizing excellence in robot design and engineering.
